# **Making Science Easier**
# 40 years of innovative DAQ software and hardware for life science

## [For Researchers][156] [For Educators][157]

ADI UPDATES

Get the Latest Research and Education News, Innovations, and Offers!

[Sign Up][158]

## **What we do**

### ADInstruments creates easy-to-use, high-quality, powerful data acquisition software and
### [equipment][159] for life science [researchers][160] and [educators][161] around the world. We
### focus on excellent design, usability, and premium customer service so you can make
### groundbreaking discoveries and train the scientists of the future.

## **Research**

Record and analyze physiological signals from human and animal subjects with our fully-integrated
analog-to-digital data acquisition systems. Our industry-leading range of DAQ software and hardware
provide real-time, high-speed analysis of digital and analog signals. From implantable pressure
recording devices to tissue isolation systems; ADInstruments provides  USB data acquisition systems
to make your research a reality.

[LabChart 8][162] data acquisition software seamlessly interfaces with the [PowerLab][163] DAQ
hardware unit to provide you with the most advanced data logging and analysis software for
physiological, biological, and biomedical research. Specialize your data acquisition and analysis
systems with our suite of analysis modules, and streamline your workflow using our trusted DAQ
software.

[ADInstruments Products - Research]

[Research Products and Services][164]

## **Education**

Engage your science students in active learning with our integrated teaching solutions. Save time
and teach flexibly by providing cutting-edge educational content, data acquisition, and data
analysis tools to your learners - whether in class or online.

The only cloud-based learning platform for data acquisition, [Lt][165] works with USB-based
[PowerLab Sensors][166] for authentic real-time physiological signal recording. Combine hands-on
learning with 900+ interactive and customizable lessons, intuitive authoring, and student grading
and learning analytics to streamline your teaching inside and outside the lab. Don't have a reliable
Internet connection? Our lab-based learning platform, [Lt LabStation][167], lets you teach
effectively with PowerLab Sensors in an offline lab environment.

[ADInstruments Products - Education]

[Education Products and Services][168]

## **Building solutions** to **scientific problems**





**Michael Macknight**  Co-founder, Director

### Established in 1986, ADInstruments has grown a lot over the decades, but some things haven’t
### changed. We are still driven to develop innovative data acquisition solutions to meet the needs
### of scientists and educators.

[Learn more][169]

## **Research**

Record and analyze physiological signals from human and animal subjects with our fully-integrated
analog-to-digital data acquisition systems. Our industry-leading range of DAQ software and hardware
provide real-time, high-speed analysis of digital and analog signals. From implantable pressure
recording devices to tissue isolation systems; ADInstruments provides  USB data acquisition systems
to make your research a reality.

[LabChart 8][162] data acquisition software seamlessly interfaces with the [PowerLab][163] DAQ
hardware unit to provide you with the most advanced data logging and analysis software for
physiological, biological, and biomedical research. Specialize your data acquisition and analysis
systems with our suite of analysis modules, and streamline your workflow using our trusted DAQ
software.

[ADInstruments Products - Research]

[Research Products and Services][164]

## **Education**

Engage your science students in active learning with our integrated teaching solutions. Save time
and teach flexibly by providing cutting-edge educational content, data acquisition, and data
analysis tools to your learners - whether in class or online.

The only cloud-based learning platform for data acquisition, [Lt][165] works with USB-based
[PowerLab Sensors][166] for authentic real-time physiological signal recording. Combine hands-on
learning with 900+ interactive and customizable lessons, intuitive authoring, and student grading
and learning analytics to streamline your teaching inside and outside the lab. Don't have a reliable
Internet connection? Our lab-based learning platform, [Lt LabStation][167], lets you teach
effectively with PowerLab Sensors in an offline lab environment.

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —

repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

## Restoring Lives

Our commitment to restoring lives has been fundamental in making us a global leader in medical
technologies and providing innovative solutions in surgical, neurologic and regenerative care. At
Integra, we work with one central goal: to create healthier people, a healthier workplace and a
healthier world.

We are the global leader in neurosurgery, offering a broad portfolio of products and solutions for
dural access and repair, cerebral spinal fluid management and neuro-critical care.

Our versatile and evidence-based regenerative technologies for soft tissue reconstruction will
treat, repair and protect patients with acute and chronic complex wounds and burns.

We provide advanced solutions for plastic and reconstructive surgery, complex hernias, and nerve and
tendon repair and protection that support the body's natural restorative healing process.

Explore the technological advancements in instrumentation and lighting; our solutions play a vital
role before, during and after a medial procedure leading to better patient outcomes.

[Fiona Heinen]

## Restoring Lives

Our commitment to restoring lives has been fundamental in making us a global leader in medical
technologies and providing innovative solutions in surgical, neurologic and regenerative care. At
Integra, we work with one central goal: to create healthier people, a healthier workplace and a
healthier world.

[ View our 2024 ESG Report ][144]
[Woman on mountain]

## Unleashing Possibilities in Patient Care

[ [brain scans]

### Neuro

We are the global leader in neurosurgery, offering a broad portfolio of products and solutions for
dural access and repair, cerebral spinal fluid management and neuro-critical care.
][145] [ [Doctors suturing]

### Wound Reconstruction and Care

Our versatile and evidence-based regenerative technologies for soft tissue reconstruction will
treat, repair and protect patients with acute and chronic complex wounds and burns.
][146] [ [Doctor in surgery wearing magnifying lenses]

### Surgical Reconstruction

We provide advanced solutions for plastic and reconstructive surgery, complex hernias, and nerve and
tendon repair and protection that support the body's natural restorative healing process.
][147] [ [Medical professional organizing medical tools on a tray]

### Surgical Instrumentation and Lighting

Explore the technological advancements in instrumentation and lighting; our solutions play a vital
role before, during and after a medial procedure leading to better patient outcomes.
][148] [ [Doctor performing a procedure on a patient's ear]

### Ear, Nose and Throat

Partnering with physicians to deliver new technology that enables safe, fast and effective
treatments in ENT.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and

complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]
Previous Next

2. Medtronic AI Compass
3. Medtronic AI Compass
4. Medtronic AI Compass

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]
Previous Next
1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# ... because monitoring the brain matters!


The NeuroWave Team welcomes you. We are dedicated to developing innovative brain monitoring and drug
delivery medical devices, powered by state-of-the-art signal processing and control engineering
technologies. Our vision is to pioneer automation in anesthesia for improved and safer patient care.

NeuroWave is proud to offer the NeuroSENSE® Monitor, the latest generation of brain monitors for
patient-customized anesthesia and sedation delivery.

## FeaturedProduct

[Products»][6]

### [NeuroSENSE Monitor ][7]

The NeuroSENSE is a unique bilateral brain function monitor with simultaneous independent indices of
anesthetic effect for each side of the brain that respond instantaneously to changes in patient
state. This offers greater insight into the brain of anesthetized or sedated patients and assists
clinicians in detecting brain function asymmetry (due to, for example, unilateral pathology) and in
making optimal decisions for safer and improved patient care.

  Annual Meeting)][10]

* Aug 4-7, 2025, Kissimmee, FL | [ NeuroWave Systems showcased its latest medical device technology
  at the Military Health Systems Research Symposium 2025 (MHSRS).][14]
* Jun 23, 2025, University of Minnesota, MN | [ We participated in the Safe Brain Initiative – EEG
  Bootcamp, where attendees received a practical introduction to EEG monitoring in anesthesia and
  critical care.][15]
* May 25-27, 2025, Lisbon, Portugal | [ ESAIC 2025 is in the books! This year’s congress was filled
  with meaningful conversations and valuable connections with leading clinicians, key clients and
  our trusted partners.][16]
* May 23-24, 2025, Lisbon, Portugal | [ We were pleased to attend and support EuroSIVA 2025, where
  experts in the field discussed the benefits of TIVA, as well as the important role of brain
  monitoring in anesthesia.][17]
* Mar 21-23, 2025, Honolulu, HI | [ It was a privilege for NeuroWave to engage with leading
  anesthesia physicians and researchers and to present our technology during IARS 2025 in

# ... because monitoring the brain matters!


The NeuroWave Team welcomes you. We are dedicated to developing innovative brain monitoring and drug
delivery medical devices, powered by state-of-the-art signal processing and control engineering
technologies. Our vision is to pioneer automation in anesthesia for improved and safer patient care.

NeuroWave is proud to offer the NeuroSENSE® Monitor, the latest generation of brain monitors for
patient-customized anesthesia and sedation delivery.

## FeaturedProduct

[Products»][6]

### [NeuroSENSE Monitor ][7]

The NeuroSENSE is a unique bilateral brain function monitor with simultaneous independent indices of
anesthetic effect for each side of the brain that respond instantaneously to changes in patient
state. This offers greater insight into the brain of anesthetized or sedated patients and assists
clinicians in detecting brain function asymmetry (due to, for example, unilateral pathology) and in
making optimal decisions for safer and improved patient care.

## Nihon Kohden Takes Pivotal Steps in Neurological Treatment Through the Acquisition of Ad‑Tech
## Medical Instrument Corporation

A Strategic Move to Further Solidify its Position in Comprehensive Epilepsy Diagnostics and Care

[View Press Release][21]

## Ad-Tech Medical Instrument Corporation

#### The World’s Leader

As the world leader, Ad-Tech's electrode devices are used in surgical cases for long-term EEG
monitoring*, brain mapping, SEEG, and brain stimulation of persons with intractable epilepsy and
other brain diseases/disorders.

**Long Term Monitoring: Device use is indicated for up to 29 days.*

#### Proprietary Design

Ad-Tech proprietary designs include subdural strip and grid electrodes, dual sided subdural
electrodes - depth electrodes - depth electrodes with micro contacts - foramen ovale electrodes -
intraoperative electrodes and spinal electrodes as well as related products including electrode
placement kits/accessory placement devices and brain biopsy needles.

#### Field Proven

Ad-Tech's devices feature design elements such as advanced materials and components as well as field
leading ease of use and connectivity, utilizing Ad-Tech's unique connection systems.

## Need More Information?

For product availability and a distributor in your country,
please contact Ad-Tech Medical directly.

[Contact Us][22]


Your browser does not support HTML5 video.

## Brooke Winter

**Corporate Controller**

Brooke leads the finance department in month end close and financial statement preparation process,
streamlining it to enable timely decision making. She also works to strengthen and improve internal
controls, managing areas such as the cycle count program and coordination of annual audits. Brooke
is also responsible for budgeting and providing support and analysis to the leadership team in
alignment with the long-term growth strategy across all areas of the business. Before joining the
Ad-Tech team in 2021, Brooke held several roles in Finance at SC Johnson, supporting areas such as
Global Supply Chain, Global Internal Audit, and Global Consumer Brands. Education includes a
Bachelors of Business Degree with a double major in Accounting and Finance from the Wisconsin School
of Business. Brooke is also a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

**[Contact Brooke][23]**

## to over a billion people

BHEL contributes more than 50% of the total power generated from conventional sources

As India’s foremost power equipment manufacturer, BHEL continues to play a pivotal role in
bolstering India’s energy security

## Harnessing the
## Power of Water

With dedicated design, engineering, erection & commissioning teams, BHEL is a one-stop solution for
Hydro Power Equipment

## Powering India
## Since 1964

amongst India's Power Plant manufacturers

## Aerospace sector

## Fueling the Aspirations
## of Emerging India

Indigenously developed & supplied sucker rod pumps for oil & gas exploration

## Serving our sentinels
## for nearly four decades

BHEL is the sole indigenous supplier of compact heat exchangers for fighter aircrafts

## BHEL - a committed Corporate
## Citizen investing in ESG

300,000+ saplings planted in last five years

## Transmission across the nation
## with state-of-the-art equipment

## Sustainable & Clean Future

## for Sustainable Development

We invest around 2.5% of our turnover in Research & Development works

## Harnessing
## Nature's Power

## Type 2 Diabetes has a significant and growing impact on patients, the NHS, and the economy

We're proud to have worked with the Company Chemists' Association to analyse the benefits of a Type
2 Diabetes screening service delivered by community pharmacies.

[ Download the report ][112]

## Donald MacDonald

I would like to see all patients in my position and those with prediabetes have access to a
nationwide screening programme. This would allow patients to be seen and treated quickly and regain
control of their lives, just as I did through the MoREM® programme.

I have been living with the condition for 12 years, however over the last year my control
deteriorated. MoREM® allowed me to understand what my HbA1c was, and then gave me the toolkit to
make changes to my diet and lifestyle through the GRO Health app. My HbA1c is below the prediabetes
range for the first time since I was diagnosed.

## Ramesh Patel

Currently one in four hospital beds are occupied by people with diabetes complications and offering
targeted support could reduce the number of people who develop diabetes in the first place.

Early diagnosis and action are key to tackling diabetes. Point-of-care testing, together with
behavioural support helps to provide patients with a clear picture of their health.

## Dr. Manisha Kumar

Over a quarter of people living in Greater Manchester will develop diabetes in their lifetime. Type
2 diabetes has a significant impact on the health outcomes of sufferer severy where as well as a
preventable cost to the NHS and wider economy. That's why Greater Manchester launch edits 'Tackling
Diabetes Together' strategy.

New models of care supporting early identification of people with Diabetes including utilising the
skills of Community Pharmacy is part of our neighbourhood delivery model and are keen to support how
we could develop more opportunities to deliver these services in Community Pharmacy settings.

Diabetes Screening
Donald Macdonald
Ramesh Patel
Dr. Manisha Kumar

## Each year, an NHS-commissioned type 2 diabetes screening service by community pharmacies could:

### SCREEN

1.5 million adults across England

### IDENTIFY

45,000 undiagnosed diabetics & 180,000 pre-diabetics

### PREVENT

over 18,000 people from developing diabetes

## Type 2 Diabetes has a significant and growing impact on patients, the NHS, and the economy

We're proud to have worked with the Company Chemists' Association to analyse the benefits of a Type
2 Diabetes screening service delivered by community pharmacies.

[ Download the report ][112]

## Donald MacDonald

I would like to see all patients in my position and those with prediabetes have access to a
nationwide screening programme. This would allow patients to be seen and treated quickly and regain
control of their lives, just as I did through the MoREM® programme.

I have been living with the condition for 12 years, however over the last year my control
deteriorated. MoREM® allowed me to understand what my HbA1c was, and then gave me the toolkit to
make changes to my diet and lifestyle through the GRO Health app. My HbA1c is below the prediabetes
range for the first time since I was diagnosed.

## Ramesh Patel

Currently one in four hospital beds are occupied by people with diabetes complications and offering
targeted support could reduce the number of people who develop diabetes in the first place.

Early diagnosis and action are key to tackling diabetes. Point-of-care testing, together with
behavioural support helps to provide patients with a clear picture of their health.

## Dr. Manisha Kumar

Over a quarter of people living in Greater Manchester will develop diabetes in their lifetime. Type
2 diabetes has a significant impact on the health outcomes of sufferer severy where as well as a
preventable cost to the NHS and wider economy. That's why Greater Manchester launch edits 'Tackling
Diabetes Together' strategy.

New models of care supporting early identification of people with Diabetes including utilising the
skills of Community Pharmacy is part of our neighbourhood delivery model and are keen to support how
we could develop more opportunities to deliver these services in Community Pharmacy settings.

Diabetes Screening
Donald Macdonald
Ramesh Patel
Dr. Manisha Kumar

## Each year, an NHS-commissioned type 2 diabetes screening service by community pharmacies could:

### SCREEN

1.5 million adults across England

### IDENTIFY

45,000 undiagnosed diabetics & 180,000 pre-diabetics

### PREVENT

over 18,000 people from developing diabetes

DekResearch is a professional R&D and manufacturer of electrochemical instruments and related
accessories (electrochemical cells, glassy carbon electrodes, reference electrodes, counter
electrodes, working electrodes and other electrochemical auxiliary products).

We provide laboratory instruments that can be widely used in electrical analysis and testing,
electrical corrosion, electrochemical testing, electrode reaction research, electrochemical reaction
mechanism research and The field of research and development of new energy materials.

So what we are actually doing is creating an added value for existing laboratory facilities. In

to whole research community.

DekResearch is a professional R&D and manufacturer of electrochemical instruments and related
accessories (electrochemical cells, electrodes, and other electrochemical auxiliary products). Our
customers are all over the world in universities, corporate scientific research institutions, and

## ABOUT OUR PRODUCTS

Since its inception, DekResearch has been dedicated to the research and development, production,
sales and service of electrochemical-related products. The company has strict product quality
requirements, high-quality raw materials, unique production technology and rigorous inspection
process to make the product quality superior and durable. Coupled with good and efficient
after-sales service, the product has been praised by many experts and scholars.

The products developed by our company include electrochemical three-electrode sensors, replaceable
electrode holder, sealed electrolytic cell,H-type replaceable membrane electrolytic cell, corrosion
electrolytic cell, photoelectrochemical cell, fuel cell, temperature-controlled electrolytic cell,
in-situ characterization reaction cells, electrochemical flow cells and other electrochemical
products.The products are favored by users at home and abroad. The products are exported to the

## ABOUT DEKRESEARCH

DekResearch is a professional R&D and manufacturer of electrochemical instruments and related
accessories (electrochemical cells, glassy carbon electrodes, reference electrodes, counter
electrodes, working electrodes and other electrochemical auxiliary products).

We provide laboratory instruments that can be widely used in electrical analysis and testing,
electrical corrosion, electrochemical testing, electrode reaction research, electrochemical reaction
mechanism research and The field of research and development of new energy materials.

So what we are actually doing is creating an added value for existing laboratory facilities. In
practice we are taking needs and opinions of scientist to create new methods that actually benefit
to whole research community.


## ABOUT OUR COMPANY

DekResearch is a professional R&D and manufacturer of electrochemical instruments and related
accessories (electrochemical cells, electrodes, and other electrochemical auxiliary products). Our
customers are all over the world in universities, corporate scientific research institutions, and
many chemical, biological, environmental protection and other fields around the world.

We are the official store who devotes itself to providing laboratory instrumentation.We have already
gained so much experience in the field of electrochemical trading and our final goal is to offer our

one of the top instrumentation online shop throughout the world and we do hope we could make you

day.

## ABOUT OUR PRODUCTS

Since its inception, DekResearch has been dedicated to the research and development, production,
sales and service of electrochemical-related products. The company has strict product quality
requirements, high-quality raw materials, unique production technology and rigorous inspection
process to make the product quality superior and durable. Coupled with good and efficient
after-sales service, the product has been praised by many experts and scholars.

The products developed by our company include electrochemical three-electrode sensors, replaceable
electrode holder, sealed electrolytic cell,H-type replaceable membrane electrolytic cell, corrosion
electrolytic cell, photoelectrochemical cell, fuel cell, temperature-controlled electrolytic cell,
in-situ characterization reaction cells, electrochemical flow cells and other electrochemical
products.The products are favored by users at home and abroad. The products are exported to the
United States, Britain, Germany, France, Australia, Singapore, Japan, Korea……

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## Procedures ### Herniated Disc What is a herniated disc? Commonly referred to as a bulging disc or a slipped disc, herniated discs can be the root of your back pain. [Learn More][38] ### Myelopathy Myelopathy refers to the condition in which the patient suffers from a gradual loss of nerve function due to disorders of spine. It can be due to a functional disturbance or pathological change in the spinal cord. [Learn More][39] ### Spinal Stenosis Pain, tingling, weakness and instability – all these can result from stenosis, a narrowing of the canal in the vertebrae that can pinch and damage the spinal cord. [Learn More][40] [Learn More][41] [Learn More][42] [Learn More][43] ### Degenerative Spine Disorders Despite the name, it is not actually a disease. But that does not mean the pain it causes is less real. It can be very painful and can affect quality of life to a great extent. Disc degeneration is a normal part of aging, but for some individuals, it can cause severe and chronic pain. [Learn More][44] ### Vertebral Compression Fracture In a vertebral compression fracture, the vertebral bone collapses. This happens when the vertebral body is vertically compressed, and weight put on the vertebra exceeds what it can endure. [Learn More][45] ### Leading Procedures Visit our Leading Procedures page to see all of the latest leading techniques and how we stay up-to-date with our approaches to spine surgery. [Learn More][46] [Learn More][47] [Learn More][48] [Learn More][49]

### Programa de Aceleración Agrifoodtech

El Programa de Aceleración AgriFoodTech es una iniciativa diseñada para fortalecer el modelo de
innovación tecnológica, transformación digital, internacionalización o atracción de inversión de
pequeñas y medianas empresas o startups con potencial de exportación de Costa Rica.

[ Ver más ][52]
Desarrollo de Habilidades Abierto

### IMPULSA 2026 – Programa de formación para mujeres empresarias

IMPULSA 2026 busca fortalecer las capacidades empresariales de mujeres en áreas estratégicas como
negocios, comunicación estratégica, innovación, sostenibilidad, finanzas, gestión de proyectos y
negociación.

[ Ver más ][53]
Acompañamiento empresarial Abierto

### Programa Integra

El Programa Nacional de Desarrollo de Suplidores tiene como objetivo fortalecer las capacidades de
los suplidores nacionales para cerrar brechas en la oferta local. Para ello, articula recursos
existentes y herramientas diseñadas específicamente para el programa, integrando tecnologías
emergentes y metodologías ágiles, con el fin de generar un impacto tangible en las Cadenas Globales
de Valor.

[ Ver más ][54]
Financiamiento Abierto

### Abordaje Investigación y Desarrollo

En alianza con Sistema Banca para el Desarrollo y el INA, PROCOMER se apoyará a las empresas en
acciones puntuales relacionadas a investigación y desarrollo, un abordaje en el marco del Programa
INTEGRA, en cual, a través de innovación aplicada, empresas suplidoras podrán transformar desafíos
productivos reales de en soluciones innovadoras con alto potencial de impacto productivo y
generación de valor agregado.

suplidoras nacionales con potencial de vinculación a cadenas globales de valor, mediante un proceso

### Programa de Aceleración Agrifoodtech

El Programa de Aceleración AgriFoodTech es una iniciativa diseñada para fortalecer el modelo de
innovación tecnológica, transformación digital, internacionalización o atracción de inversión de
pequeñas y medianas empresas o startups con potencial de exportación de Costa Rica.

[ Ver más ][52]
Desarrollo de Habilidades Abierto

### IMPULSA 2026 – Programa de formación para mujeres empresarias

IMPULSA 2026 busca fortalecer las capacidades empresariales de mujeres en áreas estratégicas como
negocios, comunicación estratégica, innovación, sostenibilidad, finanzas, gestión de proyectos y
negociación.

[ Ver más ][53]
Acompañamiento empresarial Abierto

### Programa Integra

El Programa Nacional de Desarrollo de Suplidores tiene como objetivo fortalecer las capacidades de
los suplidores nacionales para cerrar brechas en la oferta local. Para ello, articula recursos
existentes y herramientas diseñadas específicamente para el programa, integrando tecnologías
emergentes y metodologías ágiles, con el fin de generar un impacto tangible en las Cadenas Globales
de Valor.

[ Ver más ][54]
Financiamiento Abierto

### Abordaje Investigación y Desarrollo

En alianza con Sistema Banca para el Desarrollo y el INA, PROCOMER se apoyará a las empresas en
acciones puntuales relacionadas a investigación y desarrollo, un abordaje en el marco del Programa
INTEGRA, en cual, a través de innovación aplicada, empresas suplidoras podrán transformar desafíos
productivos reales de en soluciones innovadoras con alto potencial de impacto productivo y
generación de valor agregado.

[ Ver más ][55]
Desarrollo de Habilidades Financiamiento Abierto

### Abordaje Asesoría y Acompañamiento Empresarial

La asesoría y el acompañamiento empresarial como abordaje del Programa INTEGRA es una iniciativa de
la Promotora del Comercio Exterior de Costa Rica (PROCOMER) , orientado a fortalecer empresas
suplidoras nacionales con potencial de vinculación a cadenas globales de valor, mediante un proceso
estructurado de aceleración empresarial que combine diagnóstico, entrenamiento, mentoría y
seguimiento técnico.

Product Range

### Welding Electrodes Manufacturer in India — MAXIDURA Range

[Shri Balaji Alloys Corporation][120] (SBAC) manufactures welding consumables for extreme wear,
heat, and impact. Our specialised lineup includes:
* **Hardfacing Electrodes ([Maxidura Series][121]):** Overlay protection against abrasion, erosion,
  and metal-to-metal friction — crushers, cement chutes, and rolling mill parts.
* **Cast Iron Welding Electrodes:** Repair, rebuild, and join cast iron with good machinability,
  crack resistance, and strong bonding.
* **Stainless Steel & Low Hydrogen Electrodes:** Structural fabrication, high-pressure pipelines,
  and boiler work needing strength, stable arc, and corrosion resistance.

Quality Process

### Manufacturing Excellence — Welding Electrodes Manufacturer in India

At **Shri Balaji Alloys Corporation**, superior welding starts with process control. Our production
focuses on uniform flux coating and stable arc characteristics. Specifically, batch checks monitor
strength and composition so electrodes deliver reliable recovery and clean slag behaviour for heavy
engineering work.

Applications

### Industries We Serve with Industrial Welding Electrodes

Built for severe conditions where standard rods often fail — sectors that need consistent,
high-integrity welds:
* **Cement & Mining:** Wear-resistant overlays for crusher cones and excavator teeth.
* **Power & Steel Plants:** Consumables for boiler tubes, pipelines, and mill maintenance.
* **Heavy Infrastructure:** Structural fabrication and large welding projects.

In addition, our Raipur technical team helps match hardfacing alloys to your duty cycle and base
metal.

FAQ

### Frequently Asked Questions

**Which industries benefit most from [Maxidura welding electrodes][122]?**
Cement plants, mining, sugar mills, power generation, steel rolling mills, earthmoving repair
workshops, and heavy fabrication units.

**Are SBAC welding products quality-certified?**
Yes. Manufacturing follows a documented quality management system aligned with **ISO 9001:2015**
(confirm the year on your certificate and change if different), so each batch meets consistent
mechanical and weld-performance targets.

**How does hardfacing improve equipment life?**
Hardfacing deposits a wear-resistant alloy layer on the base metal. Our [Maxidura hardfacing][123]
series protects parts from grinding wear and friction — reducing downtime and replacement cost.

focuses on uniform flux coating and stable arc characteristics. Specifically, batch checks monitor
strength and composition so electrodes deliver reliable recovery and clean slag behaviour for heavy
engineering work.

high-integrity welds:

Cement plants, mining, sugar mills, power generation, steel rolling mills, earthmoving repair

## Arc Welding Machines

Arc welding machines are devices that create an electric arc between an electrode and the workpiece
to melt and join metals.

## MIG Welding Machine

A MIG welding machine, or Metal Inert Gas welding machine, is a versatile and user-friendly device
designed for efficient welding of various metals, including steel, aluminum, and stainless steel.

## TIG Welding Machine

A TIG welding machine, or Tungsten Inert Gas welding machine, is a precision tool designed for
high-quality welding of various metals, including aluminum, stainless steel, and titanium.

Welding consumables are essential materials used during the welding process to create a strong,
durable bond between metal pieces.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.
